representation_gap_rule: v0.1 search arms cover only the monomial family; the generator also draws exponential, two-term and regime laws. The PRIMARY (joint) endpoint includes every world. representation_limited_rule: a (kind, presentation) cell is REPRESENTATION_LIMITED when monomial_enumeration's full-credit rate has a cluster-bootstrap 95% lower bound >= 0.5 at the formal tier: that cell measures the representation, and no lift there is credited as reasoning (analysis.representation_limited; the candidate is capped at its comparator there).
